newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Biogen upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Biogen upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc said Tuesday it upgraded Biogen Inc to buy from attractive after extensive talks with management.
-- Biogen's stock is down more than 15 percent in the last three weeks without any change in the underlying fundamentals of the company, creating a buying opportunity, Vector said.

-- Vector said the company is expected to beat the Street's earnings estimate of $1.37 a share for fiscal 1997 and Vector's estimate of $1.45. The one-year stock price target remains $57, Vector said.
-- Biogen is a pharmaceutical development company.
-- It shares were off two Tuesday afternoon at 40.
